verdict.line: You lose it if you poke passively and let Garen's Perseverance erase your chip damage; you win it the moment you bank 50+ Fury and he has no Q up to answer the stun.

brief.thesis: This is a fight between two resource-gated power spikes: Garen's Perseverance heals him back to full whenever he goes a few seconds untouched, while Renekton's Fury bar (built by auto-attacking) unlocks a far bigger W stun and Q once it crosses 50. Whoever forces the other to fight on their own terms — constant pressure denying Perseverance, or a banked-Fury all-in — wins the exchange. At 50.3% over 193 games this is genuinely even, so the deciding factor is trade discipline, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: Garen goes a few seconds unhit
theirWindow.what: Perseverance kicks in and regenerates a chunk of his health per second, quietly erasing whatever poke damage you landed. Never walk away after a single auto or Q trade — follow up immediately or the damage is wasted.

yourWindow.when: Fury above 50 and his Q (Decisive Strike) is down
yourWindow.what: Land empowered W (Ruthless Predator) for the 3-hit, shield-destroying, 1.5s stun, then Q (Cull the Meek) and E (Slice and Dice) to dump your full combo. Without Q up, Garen has no silence to interrupt your follow-through, so this is your cleanest all-in window.

start.why: The most-picked start (79%) at a 52% win rate over 196 games — the extra sustain and AD let you commit to the auto-attack trades that both build your Fury and deny Garen's Perseverance tick.

boots.why: 85.2% pick rate at 49.5% win rate. Garen's entire kit — autos, E (Judgment), Q's bonus-damage hit — is physical, so flat armor blunts every trade pattern he has.

core.why: Triggers off the burst you land with an empowered W stun, giving you a shield exactly when Garen tries to punish your all-in.
E already shreds armor on hit; Cleaver's stacking shred compounds it, letting you chew through Perseverance's healing faster than he can regenerate it.
Most common third item (71% win rate over 31 games in this path). Converts damage taken during Garen's E spin into delayed damage, keeping you above his R execute threshold.

situational.when: he's landing his R (Demacian Justice) reliably or you need more raw HP to survive dives
the lane goes long and you want W and E back up faster for repeated all-ins
you're grouping with another auto-attack-reliant ally for skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: 45.3% pick rate at 53.6% win rate. Conqueror rewards the exact pattern this matchup demands — sustained auto-attacking to build stacks — and the healing it grants directly counters trading into a champion with his own passive sustain.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (85.2% pick rate, 51.7% win rate) and lets you close out an all-in the moment your empowered W lands. Flash + Teleport runs a higher win rate (56.3% over 29 games) if you'd rather play the wave/tempo game and avoid committing to early all-ins.

playing.title: Auto-attack between every cooldown
playing.detail: Every free auto both builds Fury toward your 50-threshold and keeps Garen's Perseverance from ever ticking. Passive trading loses you this lane; constant contact wins it.

playing.title: Bank Fury before committing W
playing.detail: A sub-50 Fury W is a single 0.75s stun for moderate damage. Waiting a few autos for the empowered 3-hit, shield-destroying, 1.5s stun version turns the same cooldown into a near-guaranteed follow-up kill window.

playing.title: Track his Q before you dash in
playing.detail: Decisive Strike breaks slows and silences on hit. If you E in while his Q is up, he can silence you out of your W/Q follow-up. Wait for him to spend it, or bait it with a non-committal poke first.

playing.title: Don't E to disengage
playing.detail: Slice and Dice sits at 16-10s cooldown depending on rank — burning it to escape a bad trade leaves you without your main all-in tool for a long stretch. Save it for combos.

playing.title: Respect the execute once his R is up
playing.detail: Demacian Justice starts at a steep 140s cooldown but drops to 50s then 20s at higher ranks. From level 9 onward, don't fight him below the HP threshold where his ult one-shots you.

playing.title: Use Dominus to reset the all-in, not start it
playing.detail: R gives bonus health and periodic Fury generation while active — pop it mid-fight once you're already trading, so the extra Fury refuels your empowered W/Q for a second stun cycle.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, item paths, rune pages, and summoner spell splits above are measured from live games on the current patch (193 head-to-head games); the mechanical reasoning — Fury thresholds, Perseverance timing, Q silence windows, R execute breakpoints — is my own read of the ability text, not OP.GG's.

stats.opponentTip: Attack Garen constantly to prevent his (P) from activating. Build up Fury and engage whenever Renekton has reinforced skills.
